title: Shell v2 — collapsible sidebar + config-driven nav. Supersedes PersonaNav.
context: The product has grown past what a top-nav + dense Header can carry cleanly. Phase 1 shipped four persona pages (treasurer / admin / compliance / approvals); the AuthN substrate added a profile MFA page; the parked PHASE_2_ADMIN_UI_PLAN adds oracle mappings + SSO group map + integration health; the parked Admin MFA tab, upcoming notifications, upcoming activity feeds. A horizontal persona tab-bar + a dense treasurer-only Header cannot carry this surface without becoming cluttered — a user review flagged it explicitly before any new feature work landed. The user's requirement: 'a menu thing that will open up and reveal children, everything configurable.'
decision: A single sidebar + topbar shell wraps every signed-in page. Groups in the sidebar expand to reveal children; the sidebar itself collapses to an icon rail; both prefs are per-user and persist in localStorage. The nav tree is a single lib/nav-config.ts array — adding a page is one entry, hiding something per role is one `requiresAnyRole` field. The topbar carries a breadcrumb + per-page actions slot + user dropdown. Pre-sign-in flows (/activate) opt out — the SHELL_EXEMPT_ROUTES list documents the carve-outs.
scope_in: frontend/components/shell/AppShell.tsx — the outer wrapper every page uses.
frontend/components/shell/Sidebar.tsx — collapsible groups + rail-collapse + Ctrl/Cmd+\ keyboard shortcut + role gating.
frontend/components/shell/Topbar.tsx — breadcrumb + per-page actions + dropdown menu with Security + Sign out. Also exports ContextStrip for pages that want the dense status row.
frontend/components/shell/PageHeader.tsx — in-content title/description/icon block that pages render themselves (not provided by AppShell).
frontend/lib/nav-config.ts — the single source of truth for nav entries.
frontend/lib/ui-prefs.ts — localStorage-backed per-user preference reader/writer, try/catch-wrapped against private windows.
frontend/lib/session.ts — new setUser() export so whoAmI() can rehydrate the in-memory user without touching the token.
frontend/lib/api.ts — whoAmI() now calls setUser() on success. Side-effect, backward-compatible.
scope_out_deferred: Admin-configurable nav. User-only prefs today. If a tenant wants to hide groups the admin UI around tenant_setting can land later.
Mobile layout. The sidebar auto-collapses on narrow viewports but a proper slide-out drawer is a separate kickoff.
Keyboard command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K). Complementary to the sidebar; not in scope.
Rebase feature/mfa-ui onto this shell. Parked on its own branch; separate follow-up.
Admin page split into /admin/users + /admin/system-policy sub-routes. Nav-config lists them but the backend still serves /admin as one page; those links 404 until the split lands.
invariants: Every signed-in page wraps in <AppShell>. A new page added without the wrapper looks like a bug (missing sidebar + topbar).
Nav entries live in nav-config.ts. Adding a page by hand-editing the Sidebar component means you missed the config.
Role gating uses requiresAnyRole on NavGroup. Changing a role requirement = one config edit, no component edit.
Shell-exempt routes stay in SHELL_EXEMPT_ROUTES (PageHeader.tsx). Adding one without the list entry is a documentation lapse.
consequences: frontend/components/PersonaNav.tsx — DELETED. Supersedes ADR-0009's role-gated top-nav rule.
frontend/components/PageShell.tsx — DELETED. Pages wrap themselves in AppShell + PageHeader.
frontend/components/Header.tsx — DELETED. The dense treasurer-only chrome moved to ContextStrip + Topbar actions.
frontend/app/page.tsx — migrated to AppShell. TreasurerTopbarActions component inlined for the Nightly/Paste/Reset buttons.
ADR-0009 superseded — persona pages still sit behind role nav, but the nav is now the sidebar.
ADR-0001 (one surface, one panel) and ADR-0016 (compliance tab shell) unchanged — those rules operate inside the page body, which the shell doesn't touch.
